speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Don't feel bad Leonard, negative results are still results.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Alright, please don't cheer me up anymore.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: C'mon, don't let him get to you. It's Kripke.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: That's why he eats by himself, instead of sitting here at the cool table.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Hey it's true, Kripke lacks the basic social skills that we take for granted, but he also controls the new open science grid computer that I need to use to run some simulations of structure formation in the early universe.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Good luck getting time on it. The only people he lets use it are his friends.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well then, the solution is simple. I shall befriend him. Kripke! What'd you say of the idea of you and I becoming friends?

speaker: barry_kripke
text: I would say, I have no intewest in becoming your fwiend.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Really? That seems rather short sighted, coming from someone who is generally considered altogether unlikable. Why don't you take some time to reconsider?
